info.title: API.SH: realestate.co.nz
info.description: The realestate.co.nz API from API.SH: public realestate.co.nz data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One realestate.co.nz listing: everything in a search result plus the full description, features, floor plans, videos, virtual tours, nearby schools (with zoning) and childcare, broadband and links, with the price history, open homes, the office (name, phone, email, website, logo) and agents (name, phone, mobile, email, photo); a private listing has no office or agents. Give the listing `id`, a realestate.co.nz listing link as `url`, or `latest=true` with the search params to open the first current result. Also the auction, tender or deadline-sale date (`deadline`), council rates (`rates`, `rates_period`), body-corporate levy (`body_corp_levy`, `body_corp_levy_period`), area units (`floor_area_unit`, `land_area_unit`), full bathrooms and the agency's offer and document links (`action_links`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/realestate-nz-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (id of a search result).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: run the search with the other params and open its first current result.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One New Zealand property's record: address and coordinates, bedrooms, bathrooms, parking, floor and land area, building age, the council valuations (capital, land and improvements value) over time, the estimated value range and its history, the sales history, the listing it sold through, its current, matched and rental listings and recent sales nearby. Property ids are in `/realestate-nz/v1/sold` results.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/realestate-nz-property

parameters.description: The property id. id or url is required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A realestate.co.nz/property/... link, instead of id.

get.description:
Listings on realestate.co.nz (New Zealand) for sale, rent and lease (residential, rural, lifestyle, commercial, business) with the site's filters: place (region, district or suburb), nearby suburbs, office, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, land and floor area, car parks, property types, keywords, open homes, mortgagee sales, new builds, waterfront, pool, pets, floor plans, videos, 3D tours, furnishing and recent price changes, plus sort. Each result has id, link, listing number, category, property type, status, headline, price text, price history, rooms, parking, areas, flags, published date, address with coordinates, open homes, photos, the office and agents (a private listing has none), and the auction, tender or deadline-sale date (`deadline`), council rates (`rates`, `rates_period`), body-corporate levy (`body_corp_levy`, `body_corp_levy_period`), area units (`floor_area_unit`, `land_area_unit`: the land area can be in hectares), full bathrooms and the agency's offer and document links (`action_links`). `aggregations.property_types` counts results by type. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/realestate-nz-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A region (auckland, wellington, canterbury...), a district path (auckland/auckland-city), a suburb path or a place name (Ponsonby); see /realestate-nz/v1/places.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price (NZD; per week for rentals).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price (NZD; per week for rentals).

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Residential types, comma list: house, apartment, studio, townhouse, unit, home_and_income, lifestyle_property, lifestyle_section, section.

parameters.name: property_type_ids
parameters.description: Other property type ids (numbers), comma list.

parameters.name: open_home
parameters.description: Only listings with an open home.

parameters.name: furnished
parameters.description: Furnishing (rentals), comma list: furnished, unfurnished, partly.

parameters.name: price_changed
parameters.description: Price changed in the last 28 days.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Properties in New Zealand with a recorded sale on realestate.co.nz: address and coordinates, bedrooms, bathrooms, parking, floor and land area, building age, the latest sale (date, price, method, days to sell, settled), the listing it sold through (title, asking price, days listed, photo), full sales history, council valuations (capital, land and improvements value) and the current estimated value range. Filter by place, sale date, sale price, bedrooms, bathrooms, land and floor area; sort by sale date, sold price or estimate. `sold_after` defaults to one year ago. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/realestate-nz-sold

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Region, district path or suburb (a name or path from /realestate-nz/v1/places, e.g. auckland, auckland/auckland-city or ponsonby).

parameters.name: sold_after
parameters.description: Sold on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: one year ago).

parameters.name: sold_before
parameters.description: Sold on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default latest: most recent sale first).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
